name: parallel-retrieval-demo
description: Retrieval Demo — Sparse Search, Honest About Its Limit: a pure-Python TF-IDF search engine over 12 Web3-security documents that demonstrates ranking, evaluation, and the known failure modes of sparse retrieval.
highlights: Demonstrates sparse retrieval with TF-IDF and cosine similarity.
Includes a demo query that correctly ranks the relevant Web3-security document first.
Evaluates 5 test queries with a 5/5 top-1 accuracy result.
Explicitly documents a known failure case for sparse retrieval: seed phrase vs recovery words mismatch.

files.description: The full demo implementation in a single standard-library-only Python file.
Project overview, run instructions, and explanation of the retrieval demo.

notes: This project is intentionally a sparse baseline and does not use a neural network or embedding model.
The project is meant to illustrate the limitations of sparse retrieval and motivate the need for dense embedding-based retrieval approaches.
